verificationMethod: Read each cited source passage and reviewed the correct answer and all three alternatives against the precise question. Source excerpts retain words from the chapter API with footnote markers omitted. Reviewed all existing 130 story questions and the new batch for repeated tested facts; new questions about previously used episodes test different facts.
